The kitchen was brightly lit, with sunlight streaming through the window onto the table. I turned left again and started walking down the stairs, which were dimly lit. At the bottom of the stairs, I turned right and entered the living room. There were several people sitting around the table, engaged in conversation. I walked towards the table, picked up a bowl from the floor, and placed it on the table. Then, I turned left and walked back to the stairs, continuing down until I reached the basement.
